purpose: Establish receiver task capability and end-to-end message plumbing before any protocol ranking.
hypothesis: If the receiver cannot solve the five paired episodes with the correct target supplied directly, then observed communication-format differences on this task are not interpretable as protocol utility.
scope: A staged local capability screen only. The plain-English arm is a feasibility reference, not an optimized natural-language baseline. No language superiority claim is possible from this screen.

task.sampling: Select one held-out candidate set and enumerate each of its five meanings exactly once as private target; keep identical candidate order in each episode.
task.candidate_order_side_channel: eliminated and tested; ordering is independent of target

conditions.receiver_view: candidate set plus direct English description of the private target
conditions.purpose: receiver capability ceiling; not a communication condition
empirical model behavior against the analytic 20% Bayes reference

conditions.receiver_view: candidate set plus exact sender-produced plain-English message
conditions.purpose: end-to-end message-pipeline feasibility, not a protocol ranking

stopping_rule: Execute full_information first. Continue to no_message and natural_language only if all five full_information outputs are strict-valid and exactly correct. Otherwise stop this task/model pair and diagnose capability or output-contract failure. The runner enforces this rule for executed follow-up batches by requiring a full-information ledger with exactly these five episode IDs, targets, and candidate orders, all exact and format-valid, and the same receiver model, tokenizer, and model population.

execution.endpoints: loopback OpenAI-compatible server must already be running; non-loopback endpoints and redirects are rejected
execution.runtime_resource_monitor: The preflight is a launch gate, not a live monitor; the externally managed model server must retain its own runtime stop safeguards.
execution.resource_gate: Pass the unchanged read-only resource gate before each model batch; local inference only; execution requires a passing same-host report no more than five minutes old, with the configured loopback ports checked free before service startup. The runner checks the report against the frozen thresholds before writing output or contacting endpoints. This preregistration does not authorize bypassing the gate.

costs: complete reported input/output tokens per model call
outcomes.claim_limit: Five episodes are a capability screen and cannot estimate a stable generalization rate or support equal-budget protocol superiority.

follow_up_gate: Only after full-information success and plumbing validation, preregister a larger held-out comparison with development-tuned natural language, valid JSON, compact structured text, symbolic code with setup charged, no-message and oracle controls, multiple receiver families, and equal byte/token budget curves.

implementation.follow_up_gate: --capability-ledger; validated before creating output files or contacting endpoints
